epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce application startup connection failures on port 18080 from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The backend application container must successfully start and respond to health checks on port 18080 without connection refused errors

slices.title: Fix backend application startup and health check response
slices.jtbd: When implementing the startup fix for this epic, I want to resolve the connection refused error, so that the launched environment is healthy and accessible.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a launched backend application container
When the system makes an HTTP GET request to localhost:18080/health
Then the application must accept the connection and return an HTTP 200 OK status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce connection refused errors on port 18080 from 100% to 0%
